package db

// Diagnostic overlay only. This file is never part of the pristine checkout.
import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type m0Observation struct {
	WallStart int64
	Before runtime.MemStats
}

func m0ObservationBegin() m0Observation {
	var state m0Observation
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&state.Before) // Before ResetTimer, never per operation.
	state.WallStart = time.Now().UnixNano()
	return state
}

func m0ObservationEnd(b *testing.B, state m0Observation, latencies []time.Duration) {
	wallEnd := time.Now().UnixNano() // After StopTimer, before inspection/export.
	var after runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&after)
	type operation struct {
		Ordinal int `json:"ordinal"`
		Type string `json:"type"`
		DurationNS int64 `json:"duration_ns"`
	}
	operations := make([]operation, len(latencies))
	for i, duration := range latencies {
		kind := "point"
		if i%2 != 0 { kind = "range" }
		operations[i] = operation{i, kind, duration.Nanoseconds()}
	}
	path := os.Getenv("MVCC_M0_OPERATIONS")
	if path == "" { b.Fatal("diagnostic overlay requires MVCC_M0_OPERATIONS") }
	stream, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
	if err != nil { b.Fatal(err) }
	// MemStats includes NumGC, PauseTotalNs, all PauseNs/PauseEnd ring entries,
	// GCCPUFraction and allocation counters. The ring may wrap; do not invent
	// pauses or label the interval between operations as an operation start.
	err = json.NewEncoder(stream).Encode(struct {
		Benchmark string
		WallStart, WallEnd int64
		Before, After runtime.MemStats
		Operations []operation
	}{b.Name(), state.WallStart, wallEnd, state.Before, after, operations})
	closeErr := stream.Close()
	if err != nil { b.Fatal(err) }
	if closeErr != nil { b.Fatal(closeErr) }
}
